authority: #K2-400 sec.6 items 1-3 (the meter-fix window; zero exam runs).

item1_failclosed_asset.implemented: regen._verify_moves_applied() + a fail-closed guard in mech_probe_moves: any requested ref whose produced-board pad != l14 + delta => named `move_not_applied` + gen_exit 1 (refuse).
item1_failclosed_asset.verified: single-ref J13 probe => move_not_applied named (expected [31.75,50.54], got [31.75,46.54]); a ref that DOES move (U2) is unaffected.
item1_failclosed_asset.regression: test_C400_the_gate_never_silently_accepts_an_unapplied_move (independent verification; RED at R1102, GREEN now)

item2_affected_set_bounded.headline: EVERY CONNECTOR's +4mm down move NEVER LANDED on the probed board => the A-double-prime / A-triple-prime / coherent-seed derivations' connector steps were VACUOUS, and their 'gate PASS' meant nothing. U1's single +4mm down step is a REAL gen refusal (not an application artifact) => U1's 'no step' is (at least for this step) real.

item3_real_placement_source.finding: gen_v5 documents L2/PLACEMENT_SOLUTION_v1.json as the canonical single source, and edit_placement_at edits exactly that file in the shadow; yet 5 connectors' edits do not reach the produced board => the ref->entry lookup used by edit_placement_at ('refs'/'components'/'placements') and the generator's reader disagree for those refs.
item3_real_placement_source.status: REAL SOURCE IDENTIFIED AT THE FILE LEVEL; the exact per-ref key divergence is the remaining one-step fix (or a named 'unmovable via this path' declaration).
item3_real_placement_source.file_level_CONFIRMED: gen_v5.load_placement() reads PLACEMENT_PATH = L2/PLACEMENT_SOLUTION_v1.json and returns {r: tuple(v['at'])} from d['refs'], requiring EVERY K2_REF to be present (fail-closed otherwise); all five affected connectors (J13/J9/J12/J6/J11) ARE present under refs, and edit_placement_at edits exactly that key => the EDIT and the DOCUMENTED READER point at the same place.
item3_real_placement_source.therefore: the coordinates must be OVERRIDDEN downstream for those refs (a connector placement rule / square-up / edge-snap, or a later stage re-deriving connector positions) - i.e. the generator's EFFECTIVE source for connectors is NOT the edited field even though the documented source is.
item3_real_placement_source.remaining_one_step: name that downstream override for the five connectors and either make the edit reach it or declare the refs unmovable via this path (#K2-400 sec.6 item 3, 'one of the two, must be filed').
item3_real_placement_source.denied_hypothesis: the only J13/J9 special-case in build_device_table is the `value` field (J_SWD / J_OOB_HEADER); the COORDINATE is unconditionally dev[ref]['at'] = ref_pos[ref] = the edited PLACEMENT_SOLUTION entry.
item3_real_placement_source.file_level_verdict: edit_placement_at reports the 5 connectors APPLIED (writes refs[ref]['at']) and gen_v5 reads exactly that field, yet the produced board shows them unmoved => the override is NOT in the documented source chain; it is downstream and NOT yet named.
item3_real_placement_source.declaration_per_K2_400_sec6_3: FILED (second option): the five connectors are declared **NOT MOVABLE VIA THE CURRENT EDIT PATH** until the downstream override is named. The meter now NAMES every such case (move_not_applied), so the defect can no longer pass silently.
item3_real_placement_source.open_one_step: name the downstream override for J6/J9/J11/J12/J13 (candidates: a connector placement stage in the k2_p4_build_l9 `crtyd`/later stages, or a re-emit of connector coordinates from the YAML sheets) and then either make the edit reach it or keep the declaration.

K2_402_declaration.rule: #K2-402 sec.2.1 second option: connectors are NOT movable via the placement path.
K2_402_declaration.evidence: edit_placement_at writes refs[ref]['at']; gen_v5.load_placement() returns ref_pos from that same field and the emitter writes (at x y rot) from dev[ref]['at']=ref_pos[ref]; the only J13/J9 special-case is the `value` field. Yet the produced board is unmoved => the override is outside the documented chain and remains UNNAMED.
K2_402_declaration.consequence: their changes go via the BOARD-LEVEL ECO path (governance: J9/J6 removal, J11 already netlist-side removed - per #K2-345/#K2-377).

per_K2_400.anti_idling: item 1 asset + regression DELIVERED => the window's hard precondition is met.
per_K2_400.next: read-only re-verification on the FIXED meter is now possible (which steps actually land; whether U1 truly has no legal step).
